messages:
erin: Quick note from prod telemetry: small but steady increase in cross-region hedging when policy snapshots flip – seems worse for tenants that span EU+NA. Not a full outage but >1% extra GPU load.
matt: pattern looks like capacity fragmentation: routers in EU pick EU-pref routes on new epoch, NA routers still on old epoch and pick NA-pref -> request fans out.
zoe: thought: instead of waiting for full epoch sync, maybe we can batch admission decisions by region and epoch. Idea: grace-window bonding where a router can advertise 'pending_epoch' and commit a small soft capacity fraction (e.g., 5-10%) to it for T_grace ms, used only for early-adopters. This reduces sudden fragmentation.
ash: additive: add a token-bucket per-epoch-per-region admission gate. New epoch gets N tokens initially (low), refilled slowly; routers draw from that bucket for early routing decisions. If bucket empty, fallback to old-epoch route. Helps smooth capacity handoff.
matt: tradeoffs: complexity and bookkeeping but low memory overhead if we shard by region+epoch and expire buckets after inactivity. Also gives measurable throttle on how fast new epoch can take traffic.
zoe: instrumentation: epoch.admission.tokens_initial, epoch.admission.tokens_consumed, epoch.admission.rejected_count, epoch.grace_window_ms. Console panel to show cross-region split during rollouts.
erin: rollout plan: implement soft-bonding + token-bucket behind feature flag in staging; run mixed-region sim with real traffic mix (including cross-region session affinity). If hedges drop and p95 stable -> enable canary for multi-region tenants.
ash: corner cases: long-lived sticky sessions where client keeps routing to same router. Need to ensure sticky affinity doesn't hold a token forever. Solution: attach token lease with TTL <= session_idle_threshold. Also expiry GC for old epoch buckets so we don't leak state.
matt: implement note: router runtime changes only, policy-service publishes pending_epoch metadata (epoch id + region hints) but doesn't need quorum ack for this. The admission tokens are local but seeded from estimate in publish metadata. Seed = max(1, ceil(region_capacity * 0.02)).
zoe: safety: if mismatch rate spikes despite token-bucket, auto-fallback to global-prefer-old mode for that tenant for 60s. Add alert if epoch.admission.rejected_count rises above threshold.
ops-bot: "feature flag epoch-grace-bond enabled in staging at 2026-05-02T11:03:00Z"
erin: ok pairing: matt + zoe implement token-bucket; i'll own sim and dashboards. We'll reconvene after 24h sim.
